buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Inspection clause: Visual Inspection will be done at NSPCL stores for acceptance of the material, along with the documents submitted by the vendor. 2. Guarantee/ warranty Clause: All items should be guaranteed against poor workmanship/ manufa cturing defect for a period of 18/12 months from the date of supply/ use of material, whichever is earlier. 3. PBG Clause: Not Applicable 4. Fitment Guarantee: Not Applicable

5. Documents required with Bid for Bid evaluation: Vendors are requested to submit Techno- commercial offer along with following documents [required annexure and formats are attached in bid as “Buyer uploaded ATC document”] 5.1 Nil-Deviation certificate – [Attachment 1] 5.2 Declaration by MSE bidder – [Attachment 5] 5.2a ** If the bid is submitted by the vendor other than Original manufacturer of the te ndered items, vendor shall not entitle to get MSE benefit 5.3 Declaration w.r.t. Single bid - [Attachment 9] 5.4 MII (Make in India) certificate by OEM ** If the bid is submitted by the vendor other than Original manufacturer (OEM) of the t endered items. Make in India certificate of tendered item should be from OEM 6. Documents required with Bid for Bid evaluation: Vendors are requested to submit Techno-comm ercial offer along with endorsed "Nil-Deviation certificate, tender document and SPC". Vendors are also requested to submit GA drawings of their offered valves. 7. Documents required along with material Supply: a. Guarantee/ warranty certificate. b. Vendor will submit Material Test Certificate for body material, stem, ball, seat (which is applicab le as valve type) material along with supply. c. Vendor will submit Pressure Test certificate along with supply. Test Pressure shall be as per the Valve Std. 8. Drawing & QP Approval : Not Applicable. 9. Payment Terms: 100% payment within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of the material at NSPCL Site Stores. 10. Delivery period: Delivery is as per bid schedules. However, the vendor must endeavour to sup ply material at the earliest. 11. Special Instructions: a) Items to quoted strictly, as per Item long text. In case of any ambiguity only Long text of each material to be referred. b) Any deviations in material specifications have to be clarified prior to bid submission, any clarific ations post bid opening will not be acceptable. c) Vendors have to mention the Make & model against respective item. d) Valve specifications have details of trims. However, which ever part's MOC is not provided in Sp ecification, it shall be acceptable as per the valve's IS std/ International Std /Valve manufacturer's std. e) Ball valve Bore is accepted as Full/ Reduced. Note: "Additional Specifications, Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditions, Attachments (if an y) along with Tender specifications shall be deemed unconditionally accepted by bidders, unless t here are specific representation/s and clarification/s prior to bid submission in GeM portal". . 6.
